assumptions: Image base inferred from startup literal at file offset 0x64: 0x0c100015 points to Thumb entry at offset 0x14.
Stack pointer comes from startup literal at offset 0x68. RAM extent is an experimental model, not a verified complete memory map.

Read-only image alias at 0x2c100000 inferred from matching string pointers. Debugger can opt into partial SCB/NVIC, cache and AON configuration; ROM, interrupt delivery, timers, display, Bluetooth and sensors are absent.
Optional shared execution alias at 0x00200000 is inferred from relocation and branch targets and corroborated by BES-family mapping. AON CHIP_ID inputs are experimental, not measured on the bracelet.
Demo models a single 32-bit register as plain read/write storage; its real hardware side effects are unknown.
A returned function is not evidence that the operating system boots or that modified firmware can be flashed.

limitations: Initial configuration values are zero for this experiment, not verified chip reset values.
